source: Streets of Rage 2 (Sega Genesis) sound effects, ripped set from The Sounds Resource asset 359 (media/assets/391/393998.zip). Used under the project's stated licence agreement for these sounds.
note: map = game slot -> sound-test index in raw/. The rip ships numbered, not named, so these were matched by acoustic analysis (duration, attack time, spectral centroid, low/high energy split) and have NOT been verified by ear. The V* files are the rip's voice bank: ehurt1-4 (the four short grunts V00-V03) play on an enemy taking a hit, edie1-2 (the ~1 s ones) on a KO, bdie (the long one) on a boss going down. Open sfxlab.html to audition every slot against every source sound, fix any that are wrong here, then run tools/build_sfx.sh.
